name: ui-press-3d
title: 3D Push
description: Nút có mặt bên dày 8 px như phím thật: bấm vào thì mặt trên lún xuống chỉ còn 2 px, thả ra thì bật lên bằng lò xo.

moworks.author: takayu

options.depth: [rest, pressed] px of the side band ([32, 8])
options.cursor: an optional cursor that makes the clicks
options.approach: [x, y] px the cursor comes from
options.lead: s it arrives before a click

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-button-push-3d, written here): Button 140x44 r14 sitting on an 8 px darker side band (depth; the accent mixed 50 % with the background). Press at 0.7 s: depth 8 → 2 px in 100 ms power2.out (the top face moves down 6 px, the base stays). Release at 1.3 s: depth back to 8 px on a spring k420 d24 (one small overshoot). Params: depth (8 → 2 px) · press (0.1 s, power2.out) · spring (k420 c24) · at / release.
